analyses.discordant: tasks proved by exactly one search, with a two-sided sign test
analyses.orderVsOrderings: Spearman correlation, over tasks with at least one whole-state expansion, between log10 of the original proof's number of orderings and the task's number of order-duplicate expansions; two-sided permutation p-value (10000 permutations, seed 0)

arm: menu only: the fixed menu of scripts/search_harness.py, unchanged; the model arm is not run, since it is stochastic and costs about four times as much per search

checks.C2: for every task stated in search-v0.1, both menu searches equal the committed ones (expansion records and proof), since the menu proposer is deterministic

developmentChecksBeforeRegistration: the runner was exercised on the first candidate task, whole-state search, at budget 4; no other unit was run
execution: every (task, search) unit in a fresh REPL, four units at a time, resumable

hypotheses.H22: the order-duplicate fraction of the whole-state search is below 5%
hypotheses.H23: the goal-duplicate fraction is at least 2 times the order-duplicate fraction
hypotheses.H24: the AND-OR search proves at least as many tasks as the whole-state search
hypotheses.H25: of the tasks that the whole-state search proves and the AND-OR search does not, at least half have at least one candidate discarded as entangled by the AND-OR search (undecidable if there is no such task)

measures.entangled: candidates the AND-OR search discarded as entangled
measures.goalFraction: whole-state expansions whose first goal, canonicalized, was already expanded as a first goal, over all whole-state expansions
measures.orderFraction: whole-state expansions whose goal multiset was already expanded in another order, over all whole-state expansions
measures.proved: tasks with a proof that re-verifies from the statement, per search

question: are the redundancy measures and the search comparison of search-v0.1 properties of the whole population of candidate theorems rather than of its 47-task sample
searches: those of search-v0.1 after its amendment 2, unchanged (breadth-first whole-state search with exact-state deduplication; breadth-first AND-OR search over canonical goals with the entanglement rule; closing candidates verified inside the search, sorry refused)

tasks.rule: every theorem of the slice whose proof is one `by` block of 3 to 20 steps, not generated, in (module, line) order: the candidate list of search-v0.1, all of it
